#AnkleCircumfence.description:
*** CHECK ***
Ankle level circumference of full length trouser

Calculateted
leg_ankle_circ + ease
leg_ankle_high_circ+ ease

#HipLineHeight.description:
* DO NOT CHANGE *
Calculated:
HipCircumference/20+3 + CrotchHeight

#FrontPanelWaistFront.description:
* DO NOT CHANGE *

Front panel front side width at Waist line
Calculated:

WaistGirth/10 or FrontPanelWidthFront - 0,5..1

#FrontPanelWidth.description:
* DO NOT CHANGE *

Total Front panel width at Hip line

Calculated:
HipCircumference/4

#FrontPanelWidthFront.description:
* DO NOT CHANGE *

Front panel front side width at Hip line

Calculated:
1/10 WaistCircumfence+1,5

#FrontCrotchHookWidth.description:
* DO NOT CHANGE *

Front Crotch hook guidance point at Hip line

Calculated:
HipCircumference/20 + 0,5...1

#BackPanelWidthBack.description:
*** CHECK ***
Buttock shape
Square 	H-shape 	(hip_circ/4+2)/4+0,5 	
Round	O-shape	(hip_circ/4+2)/4-0,5
Pear	A-shape	(hip_circ/4+2)/4+1…1,5 cm
Inverted	V-shape	(hip_circ/4+2)/4

#HemlineHeight.description:
*** CHECK ***
Height of the hemline from heel

This defines the length of trousers

#HemlineAddition.description:
*** CHECK ***
Additional length to hemline for turns, cuffs etc.

#HemLineStreightHeight.description:
*** CHECK ***
Streigth part  in the hemline for shortening etc.

#HemLineFrontBackDiffrence.description:
*** CHECK ***
Shifting side seam from back to front in knee and ankle
Men 	1
Women 	2

#SideShift.description:
* SPECIAL CASE *
Width of the stripe
The difference between front and back panels for trousers with stripe in the side seam.

#BackPanelCenterShift.description:
*** CHECK ***
Shifting back panel center 0 ... 2

Change shape of the back panel

#BackPanelForm.description:
*** CHECK ***
Changes the straightness of the back center

Back panel form 2...5
2..3 Round buttocks
4 normal
5 slim

#BackCenterInc.description: Increment to back center seam to make 90 angle

#BackPanelFittingInc.description:
*** CHECK ***
Fitting addition to the back seam
Reservation for further resizing of waistline. Mainly in men trousers

#BackCenterShift.description:
Shifting Center
Adjust for body shape

#BackCenterDrop.description: Dropping +value or rising  -value the back center seam from waistline

#BackDartDepth_1.description: Depth of dart in the middle of the back panel

#BackDartDepth_2.description: Depth of dart in 1/4 panel width from back center seam

#FronCenterDrop.description: Dropping +value or rising -value the front center seam from waistline

#FrontCenterShift.description:
Shifting Center seam
Adjust for body shape

#SideCurve.description:
*** CHECK ***
Side curvature at Waist line
How much is the side seam curving in

#SideDrop.description: Dropping the side from the waistline

#WaistLineCurve.description:
* DO NOT CHANGE *
The distance to create 90 degree seams

#Pleat1.description:
*** CHECK ***

Front panet pleat amount. 
Pleat widens the whole front panel

#Pleat2.description:
*** CHECK ***
Front panet pleat amount. 
Pleat widens the front panel to knee level

#PocketOpeningWidth.description:
*** CHECK ***
The pocket mouth distance from the side seam

#PocketOpeningHeight.description:
*** CHECK ***
The height of the pocket mount from the waistline

#PocketWidth.description:
*** CHECK ***
The width of the pocket in the waistline

#PocketDepth.description:
*** CHECK ***
Depth of the pocket in the front

#PocketPanelWidth.description: The width of the panel in the pocket mouth

#ZipperPanelWidth.description: The width of the zipper panel

#ButtonPanelWidth.description:
*** CHECK ***
The width of the additional button panel in the waistband
